patches.note: Unmodified PR #67 module config. Applied only by --profile unified72-egpu; no card, display output, BAR or compute qualification.

qualification: Build only; not booted. All six Aurora20 enhancements were checked against the exact #158 tree and are included in the wip4 source series. Five apply to normal unified72; AMD/Nouveau are opt-in in a separately named eGPU package profile. The M3 thermal safe-cap policy is ported as dormant tested policy code because the #158 M3 backend refuses runtime startup. J613/T8122 camera patches remain firmware/m1n1 scoped. ARM64 candidate, unified72 and unified72-egpu kernel/module/DTB builds plus package inspection passed in run 39854228647. DCP KUnit, J314S boot, dock/recovery, and eGPU/camera hardware qualification remain open.
